item.title: 8th Annual Oktoberfest at Montclair Brewery — Sat Sep 26, 1:00 PM — Montclair Brewery
item.description: Join us as we celebrate our Eighth Annual Oktoberfest on Saturday, September 26th! Indulge in a large variety of locally inspired craft beers, hard seltzer cocktails, frozen slushies, and a wide array of non-alcoholic craft drinks, such as MB Craft Root Beer, White Sorrel (also known as Bissap), Hop Water, and Pineapple Ginger Beer. Experience incredible live music all throughout the day by the following fantastic, local bands: Crow Magnum, Mea and Company, Wake Up Paul, and Lil’ Bastad! DJ PaP will be on the ones and twos getting the crowd going early on! Enjoy a taste of the delicious offerings available on-site all day by a local food vendor. Dress in your German-Best Oktoberfest attire and enter the costume contest or test your strength and join the stein-holding contest! A variety of outdoor games will be available for play to ensure everyone has a wúnderbar time! Ticket holders will receive a commemorative pin (while supplies last) and a branded wristband. VIP ticket holders

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 Minutes) — Sat Oct 3, 10:45 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled.
(Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
